in_marathi.name: Chhotan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhotan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chhatra' meaning 'younger brother' or 'younger one'. In Hindu mythology, Chhotan is a name associated with youth, vitality, and brotherly love.
